build_FrozenInTime_model: build a FrozenInTime model with video and text params for EgoNCE ITM MLM tasks
run_infer_method: run the FrozenInTime infer method on video and text data to get embeddings
run_forward_method: run the FrozenInTime forward method to compute EgoNCE MLM and ITM losses
create_sim_matrix: create a similarity matrix between two sets of normalized embeddings using sim_matrix
create_sim_matrix_batch: create batched similarity matrices between two tensor sets using sim_matrix_batch_val
